post_content:
These downloads work with the Thessley Passkey app. The SSH service and HTTPS admin page are companion software for a Windows computer; they are separate from the WordPress plugin itself.

Downloads

  • Windows SSH + Web GUI package — Windows OpenSSH QR approval service, HTTPS admin page, installer, and setup guides.
  • Desktop approval helper — a small Windows app for approving SSH requests and enrolling a phone. Requires the Windows service.
  • Experimental QR sign-in provider — changes the Windows sign-in screen. It is experimental; retain the built-in Windows PIN and password choices and follow the included rollback steps.
  • SHA-256 checksums

The ZIP files are unsigned. Verify a download against the checksum file before extracting it. The experimental credential provider is optional and is not needed for QR-approved SSH or the web admin page.

Install Windows SSH and Web GUI

1. Prepare Windows

Use Windows 11 and an administrator account. Install Python 3.10 or newer for all users under C:Program Files. For example, from an administrator PowerShell:

winget install --id Python.Python.3.13 --scope machine

Download and extract windows-ssh-webgui.zip, for example to C:ThessleyWindows-SSH-WebGUI.

2. Install the Thessley service

In an administrator PowerShell, run the installer from the extracted folder. Adjust the Python path if your installed version differs:

Set-Location C:ThessleyWindows-SSH-WebGUI
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .installinstall.ps1 `
  -Python "C:Program FilesPython313python.exe" `
  -OpenFirewall -OpenWebFirewall

The firewall options allow the phone approval service (TCP 47810) and the web page (TCP 47820) from the local subnet on Private networks. The installed service shares one approval listener across concurrent requests, so it needs only port 47810. They do not open the ports to all internet addresses. The installer does not edit sshd_config or restart OpenSSH.

3. Enrol the phone and open the web admin page

Run the included ThessleySignInTest.exe from the desktop-approval ZIP, select Enroll this account, and follow the pairing prompts. Compare the pairing codes in the phone and Windows app before confirming.

Turn on the web page and read its certificate fingerprint:

& "C:ProgramDataThessleyPamWinthessley-pam-win.cmd" web on
& "C:ProgramDataThessleyPamWinthessley-pam-win.cmd" web status

Open https://<Windows-computer-IP>:47820/ from the local network and approve the page sign-in on the enrolled phone. The browser warns about the self-signed certificate; compare its fingerprint with web status before accepting it. The Admin page can restrict the web page to 127.0.0.1; remote access then requires an SSH tunnel.

4. Configure SSH QR approval

Keep an existing administrator session open while changing SSH settings. Back up C:ProgramDatasshsshd_config first. Generate the account-specific configuration block:

& "C:ProgramDataThessleyPamWinthessley-pam-win.cmd" sshd-config --user YOURNAME --factor password

Choose the first factor deliberately:

  • --factor password: Windows account password, then phone approval.
  • --factor key: SSH key, then phone approval.
  • --factor key-password: SSH key and account password, then phone approval.

Add the generated Match User block above the stock Match Group administrators block in sshd_config. Validate before restarting:

& "C:Program FilesOpenSSHsshd.exe" -t
Restart-Service sshd

Test from a second computer while keeping the original session available for recovery. If validation fails, do not restart sshd.

Remove the service

First remove the Thessley Match User block from sshd_config, validate it with sshd -t, and restart sshd. Then run installuninstall.ps1 as administrator. The uninstall script refuses to remove the gate while sshd_config still refers to it.

Experimental Windows QR sign-in

The optional credential-provider bundle affects the Windows logon screen. It stores a machine-protected copy of the existing account password so it can submit it after phone approval; it does not remove the Windows password or PIN authentication providers. Read the included design and rollback instructions, keep a working recovery method, and do not cancel rollback until a QR sign-in has succeeded.
